display.purpose: Oversized Today headline; variable font weight and tight tracking carry the visual character.

body.purpose: Shared family for readable descriptions and compact interface copy.

label.purpose: Bold, tracked uppercase labels for fields and stage context.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft violet lift under the primary action.

shadows.name: surface-hover
shadows.purpose: Raised hover state for application cards.

shadows.name: editor-sheet
shadows.purpose: Strong edge shadow on the focused editor sheet.

motion.name: card-response
motion.purpose: Short, springy card lift on hover; removed for reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: editor-entry
motion.purpose: Right sheet enters with a gentle slide and fade; reduced-motion preference collapses the animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main add and save action, with a confident violet fill.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--violet, #6548e8); color: #fff; font: 750 13px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(80,53,200,.2); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s, transform .18s; } .ds-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--violet-dark, #4c34c4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--violet, #6548e8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet cancel or secondary choice on a bright surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #c8c4ba; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--paper-bright, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #171713); font: 750 13px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #ebe7dc; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--violet, #6548e8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:active { background: #e4e0d5; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Warm tinted text field with a clear violet focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #5d5e57; font: 800 10px/1.3 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 43px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid #d3cfc4; border-radius: 11px; background: #f7f4ec; color: var(--ink, #171713); font: 400 12px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; transition: border-color .18s, box-shadow .18s; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #77786f; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--violet, #6548e8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(101,72,232,.12); outline: 0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #6548e8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Rail link with a quiet dark highlight and lime active indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 12px 13px; border-radius: 12px; background: #30302a; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font: 650 14px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-nav-active i { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-left: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lime, #d9ff63); } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #393932; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--lime, #d9ff63); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Deadline Tag
components.description: Compact due-date signal with text and tone for today or overdue.
components.css: .ds-deadline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eeece4; color: #5d5e57; font: 750 10px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-deadline-today { background: var(--lime, #d9ff63); color: #2c3800; } .ds-deadline-overdue { background: #ffded8; color: #8a2e21; }

components.name: Application Card
components.description: Bright, compact opportunity summary with a tactile clipped monogram.

components.css: .ds-card { padding: 13px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper-bright, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #171713); box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(57,50,35,.055); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), box-shadow .22s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 25px rgba(57,50,35,.1); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--violet, #6548e8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; } .ds-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 34px; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 11px 11px 3px 11px; background: #e9e5da; font: 800 10px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-head div { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 2px; } .ds-card-head strong, .ds-card-head small { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-head strong { font: 700 11px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-head small { color: var(--muted, #6f7068); font: 400 10px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-meta { margin-top: 13px; color: #696a63; font: 400 9px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 12px 0 0; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid #ebe7dd; color: #4f504a; font: 400 10px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: On Your Radar Queue
components.description: Numbered, scannable follow-up row that foregrounds the next useful action.
components.css: .ds-action-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 13px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 13px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #ebe7dc; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #171713); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action-row:hover .ds-action-copy strong { color: var(--violet, #6548e8); } .ds-action-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--violet, #6548e8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-action-index { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; background: #e8e6de; font: 800 10px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-action-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 3px; } .ds-action-copy strong, .ds-action-copy small { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-action-copy strong { font: 700 13px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-action-copy small { color: var(--muted, #6f7068); font: 400 11px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-deadline { padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eeece4; color: #5d5e57; font: 750 10px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The Campus Editorial Planner treats a job search as a personal plan in motion. Warm paper and carbon ink make the workspace feel like a well-kept working notebook; oversized, tightly set headings give each visit an editorial point of entry. Compact metadata keeps 5–40 opportunities scannable without making the interface feel like a recruiting database.

Violet marks the primary action and moments of focus. Lime brings a quick signal to what is due today and to the momentum panel, while coral and cool secondary hues distinguish outcomes and stages. Cards, clipped corner marks, small uppercase labels, and restrained shadows add tactile character while keeping next actions in front. The interface explicitly frames progress as information rather than a score.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, carbon ink, and bright but bounded signals
Editorial display type paired with compact, practical labels
Action-first hierarchy with a tactile application pipeline

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet directs action; lime identifies immediate attention. Keep both legible and purposeful rather than using them as decorative fills everywhere.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Bricolage Grotesque Variable throughout the interface; create hierarchy through size, weight, and tracking rather than introducing a new display face.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows should clarify an interactive layer or raised surface; use paper tone and borders for ordinary grouping.

dos: Do keep the warm paper canvas and carbon text as the default working surface.
Do use violet for primary actions and focus, and lime for immediate attention or active momentum cues.
Do keep company and role prominent while secondary metadata stays compact and may truncate cleanly.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep overdue, today, and future deadlines distinguishable by both text and color.
donts: Don't turn the momentum percentage into a score or use rejection as a celebratory event.
Don't make shadows the primary way ordinary content is grouped.
Don't rely on drag-and-drop as the only way to change a stage.
Don't introduce additional type families without a demonstrated hierarchy need.
